title: Account settings
subtitle: Manage your personal details, notifications and security settings.

profile.title: Personal information & address
profile.saveFailed: The profile could not be updated.
profile.fixed: A bazaar that keeps a record accepted your items. Your name and address therefore stay as they were at the intake until the bazaar is over.

security.title: Security
security.externalPassword: You signed in with an external provider, so your password is managed there.
security.wrongOld: The current password is wrong. Please check your input.
security.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong passwords. Please try again later.
security.incomplete: The password account is not set up completely. Please contact support.
security.failed: The password could not be updated. Please try again.

digitalId.title: Digital ID
digitalId.onlyOnSite: Only needed to identify yourself on site.
digitalId.usage: Use this QR code to identify yourself when handing in items or during stocktaking.
digitalId.noScreenshot: Security note: do not use a screenshot.
digitalId.loadFailed: The digital ID could not be loaded.
digitalId.noOfflineKey: Not available without internet: open the ID once with internet, then it works offline too.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: Choose which emails you receive. Receipts and notices about your account are always sent.

sales.title: Sales
sales.description: When one of your items was sold.

buyer.title: My offers and questions
buyer.description: Answers and decisions when you want to buy something yourself.

reminders.title: Bazaar reminders
reminders.description: Information the day before the bazaar and a reminder to pick up your items.

organizer.title: Messages from organizers
organizer.description: Messages from the bazaars where you sell. Important notices still reach you.

danger.title: Privacy & danger zone
danger.intro: Under the GDPR you have the right to receive a copy of the data we store about you or to delete your account permanently.
danger.confirmText: You will be signed out and your registrations for upcoming events will be cancelled. For {{count}} days you can reactivate your account by signing in again. After that we permanently delete your name, contact details, sign-in data and unsold items. Sales remain without your profile for the organizers' settlements.
danger.isOrganizer: The account cannot be deleted because you are the organizer of an event.
danger.hasOpenSales: The account cannot be deleted yet: a bazaar still has items of yours or your payout is open. Pick up your items and get paid out; ask the organizer if anything is unclear.
danger.immediately: Delete permanently right away, without the option to reactivate
danger.pastEventsText: Hand them over to a helper so someone keeps the settlement. Otherwise the bazaar will show “Organizer: deleted account”, and only an admin can access the settlement on request.
danger.settlementExported: I exported the settlements. As organizer I am responsible for keeping them myself.
danger.isLastAdmin: The account cannot be deleted: you are the last administrator. Appoint another one first.
danger.organizesPastEvents: Please hand your past bazaars over to a helper or confirm that you exported the settlements.
